branch: B — exact finite-prior causal wind tunnel
verdict_summary: PREDICTIVE_CAPTURE_WITHOUT_POSTERIOR_FIDELITY. The PFN outperforms the exact Bayesian oracle on held-out data while its output distribution diverges from the Bayesian posterior (JS increases monotonically over training). It does not extract differential value from causal ordering (deficit ≈ gap). This establishes a reproducible regime where predictive competence exceeds posterior fidelity.
strongest_licensed_statement: On the exact K=256-atom finite prior, training causes the PFN to diverge from the Bayesian posterior in distribution while matching or exceeding its predictive accuracy. The ordering-specific component of this diverging predictive strategy is zero, consistent with uniform-order mixing.
